reports.title: Reports
reports.cellNote: Cell values are net P&L in {currency}.
reports.exportSummary: Closed trades: {trades} | Net P&L: {pnl} | Win rate: {winRate}
reports.exportGroupLine: {group}: {trades} trades | P&L {pnl} | Win {win} | Planned {planned}R | Realized {realized}R | Volume {volume} | Holding time {duration}
reports.noTradesMatch: No closed trades match these filters.
reports.multiCurrency: These accounts use different currencies ({currencies}). Select accounts with the same currency in Filters to compare monetary results.
reports.footnote: Closed trades only. Dates use the closing day; weekday and entry time use the opening time in {timeZone}. Volume is total entry quantity. R uses weighted entry and total entry quantity; missing or invalid risk inputs are excluded from R averages. Derivatives require a configured multiplier for realized R. Multiple tags or mistakes can place a trade in more than one group, so those group totals can overlap.

compare.intro: Each group has its own filters. Compare strategies, accounts, periods, or trade characteristics. Groups may overlap.
compare.currencyWarning: Select accounts with the same currency in both groups. Currency conversion is not applied.
compare.exportMetricRates: Win rate: {winRate} | Planned R: {planned} | Realized R: {realized}

overview.annotateEmpty: Annotate trades to unlock this breakdown.
overview.footnote: Weekday and hour use trade opening times. Overview trade counts include open positions; win rates use closed trades. Holding time requires a closed trade. Tags and mistakes can overlap. By symbol shows the top 20 by net P&L; Breakdowns includes every symbol and additional metrics for closed trades.

estimates.title: MAE & MFE estimates
estimates.savedSummary: {done} of {total} closed trades have saved estimates. Estimated gross excursions exclude fees; MAE is shown as a positive adverse amount. Missing values are excluded from plots, never counted as zero.
estimates.calculateHint: Loads {resolution} candles for this selection using each trade’s recorded symbol. This uses your provider allowance and may take several minutes. For custom symbols or a specific CSV dataset, load and save estimates from the individual trade.
estimates.confirmLine: I confirm these symbols, price adjustments and quote currencies match the fills and account currency ({currencies}).
estimates.singleCurrencyHint: Select accounts with one currency to calculate estimates together.
estimates.connectSettings: Connect a market data provider in Settings
estimates.statusStopped: Stopped. {saved} estimates saved · {failed} unavailable · {remaining} not processed.

trends.title: Performance trends
trends.summaryLine: {count, plural, one {# closed trade} other {# closed trades}} · Active account and filters · Closing order · {timeZone}{currencySuffix}
trends.emptyTitle: No closed trades in this selection
trends.emptyHint: Change the date range or filters to explore your trading history. Open positions are excluded.
trends.multiCurrency: These trades use different currencies ({currencies}). Win rate is available; select accounts with one currency to compare P&L and largest trades. No currency conversion is applied.
trends.pointsNoteWin: Last 20 closed trades at each point · Breakevens included
trends.pointsNotePnl: Last 20 closed trades at each point · After fees
trends.sequenceNoteWin: Closed-trade sequence · Dashed line: selected-period win rate
trends.sequenceNotePnl: Closed-trade sequence · Dashed line: selected-period average
trends.needMore: {count, plural, one {# more closed trade is needed for the first full 20-trade window.} other {# more closed trades are needed for the first full 20-trade window.}}
trends.latestWindowAvailable: Latest window available. A line chart appears at 27 closed trades, when there are 8 full windows to compare.
trends.largestNote: Individual closed trades, after fees—not daily totals. Uses your journal’s win/loss classification.
trends.noWinners: No winning trades in this selection.
trends.noLosers: No losing trades in this selection.
trends.tableCaption: Each row covers 20 trades ending at the linked trade. Dates use {timeZone}.
trends.footnote: Only trades within your selection are used; earlier trades are not borrowed to fill a window. Rolling windows overlap and describe recent results—not a forecast. Small samples can change sharply.
